title: Quarterly roadmap: Private/VPC on-prem initiative hypothesis board and E2E acceptance
creator: Maya Chen
description: Summary: This ticket captures the quarterly roadmap planning work for Private/VPC/on-prem enterprise features. Goal is to create a hypothesis board that maps proposed initiatives to OKRs, define E2E acceptance criteria and rollout gates, and align cross-functional teams (Engineering, Design, Security, Sales/CS) on tranche sequencing and resourcing. Rationale: Several enterprise customers have signaled demand for stricter isolation, predictable upgrade windows, and enhanced key management. We need a prioritized, measurable plan for Q2 activation cohorts and a clear acceptance path to reduce churn risk. Scope: - Feature slices: VPC Network Peering, Upgrade Window Orchestrator, Tenant RBAC Templates, KMS/HSM integration guide, Private control plane ops runbook. - Outputs: hypothesis board, risk/mitigation table, gated acceptance checklist, capacity/resourcing map, stakeholder sign-off matrix. Out-of-scope: low-touch infra optimizations not required for tenant activation this quarter.
acceptance_criteria: Hypothesis board populated with initiatives mapped to at least one OKR and a primary metric (latency, cost, or activation time)
E2E acceptance checklist defined for each initiative with SLO thresholds and rollback gates
Cross-functional trade-off decisions documented and approved by PM, Eng leads, and Security
Pilot cohort plan that includes 3 lighthouse customers and success criteria for activation
Resource plan and sprint allocation confirmed with Eng and Design owners for Q2 launch window
updates: 2026-02-18: Kickoff meeting with Eng infra, Security, and Solutions teams. Collected initial pain points from 4 customers; noted priority for KMS and upgrade windows.
2026-02-23: Compiled hypothesis board draft (Confluence). Decided to deprioritize multi-region routing changes this quarter to focus on isolation and upgrade telemetry.
2026-03-02: Eng provided capacity estimate: 8 weeks for Upgrade Window Orchestrator baseline + 4 weeks for tenant RBAC templates. Marked dependent on ENG-4321 (kernel scheduling work).
2026-03-05: Design review - created initial RBAC template patterns. Design requested user flows for admin and auditor personas; assigned DES-210 for mockups.
2026-03-08: Security completed preliminary threat assessment and requested KMS/HSM integration spec and a runbook for key rotation; flagged security_review_required=true.

2026-03-10: Leadership sync - approved pilot cohort approach and tranche sequencing. Agreed on three-wave rollout with automatic rollback gates based on activation error rate > 2% or CPU/latency regression > 25%.
2026-03-10: Updated due_date to 2026-03-31 for roadmap artifacts and stakeholder sign-off ahead of planning offsite.
decisions: Focus scope on operational primitives (upgrade window, RBAC templates, KMS guide) this quarter to reduce activation friction
Defer multi-region routing and advanced autoscaling until validation of isolation and upgrade flows with lighthouse customers
Adopt conservative rollback gates: activation error rate > 2% OR token latency P95 regression > 25% triggers automated rollback
Model rollout as three waves: internal pilot, 3 lighthouse customers, then broader controlled cohort
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: KMS/HSM onboarding takes longer due to customer compliance audits. Mitigation: provide a templated integration guide and automate most validation checks to shorten cycles.

Risk: Upgrade window orchestration could conflict with existing dedicated capacity autoscaling. Mitigation: opt for dark-launching the orchestrator with traffic mirroring and circuit-breakers before enabling on customer instances.
Risk: Resource contention in Eng during Q2. Mitigation: negotiate sprint allocations and push lower-impact infra refactors to Q3.
Risk: Acceptance criteria too strict and prevents rollout. Mitigation: use canary thresholds with gradual ramping and clearly documented contingency actions.
next_steps: Finalize hypothesis board and circulate for comments (owner: Maya) by 2026-03-14
ENG to post a technical spike for Upgrade Window Orchestrator and update ENG-4321 with estimates by 2026-03-17
Design to deliver RBAC admin and auditor flows (DES-210) and attach mocks to Confluence by 2026-03-20
Security to publish KMS integration checklist and required audit artifacts by 2026-03-22
Schedule stakeholder sign-off meeting for roadmap artifacts on 2026-03-25
